description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for managing web configuration database operations, including loading, updating, encoding, and decoding web configuration data, as well as handling temporary and persistent storage.

classes.name: webconfig_tmp_data_t
classes.description: Structure representing temporary web configuration data, including status, error details, retry info, and a linked list pointer.

classes.name: webconfig_db_data_t
classes.description: Structure representing persistent web configuration database entries, including name, version, and root string.

classes.name: blob_t
classes.description: Structure for binary large object data, including data pointer and length.

classes.name: blob_data_t
classes.description: Structure for individual blob entry with name, version, root string, status, and error details.

classes.name: blob_struct_t
classes.description: Structure holding an array of blob_data_t entries and their count.

methods.name: webcfgdbblob_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a blob_struct_t object, freeing associated memory.

methods.name: webcfgdb_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a webconfig_db_data_t linked list, freeing memory.

methods.name: webcfgdbblob_strerror
methods.description: Returns a string describing a blob error code.

methods.name: decodeBlobData
methods.description: Decodes a buffer into a blob_struct_t structure.

methods.name: initDB
methods.description: Initializes or loads the database from the specified file path.

methods.name: addNewDocEntry
methods.description: Adds a new document entry to the database.

methods.name: writeToDBFile
methods.description: Writes data to the specified database file.

methods.name: generateBlob
methods.description: Generates a blob representation of the database.

methods.name: get_DB_BLOB
methods.description: Retrieves the database blob.

methods.name: get_global_db_node
methods.description: Returns the current global database node.

methods.name: set_global_db_node
methods.description: Sets the global database node.

methods.name: get_global_tmp_node
methods.description: Returns the current global temporary node.

methods.name: reset_db_node
methods.description: Resets the global database node.

methods.name: set_global_tmp_node
methods.description: Sets the global temporary node.

methods.name: addToTmpList
methods.description: Adds an entry to the temporary list.

methods.name: addToDBList
methods.description: Adds an entry to the database list.

methods.name: updateTmpList
methods.description: Updates an entry in the temporary list.

methods.name: deleteFromTmpList
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the temporary list.

methods.name: getTmpNode
methods.description: Retrieves a temporary node by document name.

methods.name: delete_tmp_list
methods.description: Deletes the entire temporary list.

methods.name: delete_tmp_docs_list
methods.description: Deletes temporary documents list.

methods.name: release_success_docs_tmplist
methods.description: Releases successful documents from temporary list.

methods.name: get_numOfMpDocs
methods.description: Returns the number of MP documents.

methods.name: set_numOfMpDocs
methods.description: Sets the number of MP documents.

methods.name: reset_numOfMpDocs
methods.description: Resets the number of MP documents.

methods.name: get_successDocCount
methods.description: Returns the count of successful documents.

methods.name: reset_successDocCount
methods.description: Resets the count of successful documents.

methods.name: get_doc_fail
methods.description: Returns the number of failed documents.

methods.name: set_doc_fail
methods.description: Sets the number of failed documents.

methods.name: get_DB_BLOB_base64
methods.description: Returns the base64 encoded database blob.

methods.name: checkDBList
methods.description: Checks if a document exists in the database list.

methods.name: updateDBlist
methods.description: Updates the database list with a new document.

methods.name: checkTmpList
methods.description: Checks the temporary list for updates.

methods.name: checkTmpRootUpdate
methods.description: Checks and updates the root string in temporary list.

methods.name: writebase64ToDBFile
methods.description: Writes base64 data to the database file.

methods.name: base64blobencoder
methods.description: Encodes blob data into base64 format.

methods.name: decodeData
methods.description: Decodes a message pack buffer into a webconfig_db_t structure.

methods.name: webcfgdbparam_strerror
methods.description: Returns a string describing an error code.

methods.name: updateFailureTimeStamp
methods.description: Updates the failure timestamp for a temporary data entry.
